comment: The Atlas Team client/server protocol contract. The backend is the source of truth; the hub keeps a copy at test/fixtures/team_protocol.json and CI fails when they differ. Bump `protocol` whenever a client needs something an older server does not do, and record why below.

levels.summary: Mutation-log sync, identity, devices, official posting commands for sales, purchasing, stock, POS and payments.
C4: history checkpoint on sync pull and posting responses, GET sync/history, report-lost-history.
C5: server posts Journal Entry, Expense and Customer Deposit; books lock only through set-books-lock; settings PUT refuses a lock change; GET /protocol and the X-Atlas-Protocol header.
